name: Lucas
source:
Specialty: HW Engineer
Location: Earth (Australia)
Race: Human

Lucas led a protected life, the middle child of wealthy family, with an older brother and a younger sister. He spent most of his childhood trying to gain his father's approval ad acknowledgment. By the time he was eighteen, he had developed a predisposition for anything always being on the opposite of an argument, anything that would give him the chance to show off his intellect and oratory skills.

His sharp wit and silver tongue got him out of all sorts of unsavory situations, making for a comfortable upbringing. However, once he was out of his parents' house, Lucas found out that talking yourself in and out of a situation could only get you so far. Unemployed, alone and scared, he set out to face the reality of the outside world.

Jumping from contract to contract, he discovered his predisposition for all things mechanical. Until then, he had navigated conflicts through logic, when life landed him in an auto shop, it seemed that for once he could apply logic for a more practical resolution. Using it as an anchor for stability, he became more proficient at it, giving him the excuse he was looking for to travel the world.

Witty, charming and easy-going, Lucas feels most comfortable in a crowd, capturing his audience with a tall tale or an outlandish take on a subject A bit of a narcissist, something that he developed to keep up with his older brother and younger, more adorable sister, he values his skin very much, always making sure that he's on the winning side of an argument or conflict. The constant need for validation through others has turned him into a jack of all trades, always looking for his next "fix".
